traits.name: Egg colour (olive depth)
traits.def: 1 = sky blue, 3 = sage green, 5 = deep olive.

traits.name: Laying rate
traits.def: Eggs per week at peak lay.

traits.name: Temperament
traits.def: 1 = flighty or aggressive, 5 = calm and easy to handle.

traits.name: Heat tolerance
traits.def: 1 = panting and off lay above 30°C, 5 = active and laying in heat.

records.text: Plan: Araucana hens over a Welsummer rooster (Line W) and a Maran rooster (Line M). Blue shell plus brown coating should give olive F1s.
First olive egg from Olive at 26 weeks. Sage green with fine speckles.
Moss lays the darkest olive so far: deep khaki.
Backcross chicks (26C-2) hatched well. Expect about half to lay blue-based eggs, and darker olive than the F1s.
Move the backcross chicks from the brooder to the grow-out run
Egg colours side by side: Araucana blue, Welsummer brown, and the F1 olive in the middle.
The laying flock, all lines together.
Backcross chicks are three weeks old and feathering well. Shared for the club page.
